# `factory/guides.py`

[As built](../../README.md) › [Execution environment and infrastructure](../../subsystems/execution-environment-and-infrastructure.md) › `guides.py`

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Reads and manages guides—the repository's AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, and skill files—that instruct coding agents how to write code. Detects which guides bind at a given commit, delivers the relevant ones to agents within token budgets, and bridges guides to checkouts so runners that don't read all folders still see the rules.

1,039 lines, in Execution environment and infrastructure.
